objects: all LLD-07 tables declared by schema_sources
all LLD-07 required indexes and unique partial/current-identity guards declared by schema_sources
all LLD-07 projection/current/attention tables declared by schema_sources
ownership_rule: Every LLD-07 table, index, trigger-like invariant encoded as schema constraint, current projection and append-oriented event object declared by schema_sources is allocated only to migration sequence 7; implementation must enumerate exact DDL objects before accepted runtime migration hash freeze.
policies: All authoritative Inventory tables use SQLite STRICT where applicable and explicit FK constraints/index coverage.
Migration creates no provisional physical units, no Task lifecycle facts and no synthetic SR7/C10/FT identities.
Forward-only accepted migration bytes/hash are frozen by LLD-01; rollback is restore-from-backup rather than reverse destructive DDL.
